about: Statewide and federal-statewide contests on New York general-election ballots, 1898-1998. Compiled from English Wikipedia wikitext of the pages "{YEAR} New York state election", "{YEAR} United States presidential election in New York", "{YEAR} United States Senate election in New York", "{YEAR} United States Senate special election in New York", "{YEAR} New York gubernatorial election", and, for 1982-1998 years with no state-election results table, "{YEAR} New York State Comptroller election" and "{YEAR} New York Attorney General election". Each contest carries its source page in "src". Values not present in the source are null; years with no source page are absent. "label": office wording on the source page when it differs from "office". "vf": number of seats (rows with the same office label on the page). "p": every party line the candidate appeared on; "pv": per-line votes where the source gives them; "vSum": true when v is the sum of "pv" (the source gives no combined figure); "vNote": vote-figure caveat. "vpMissing"/"ltMissing": the source names no running mate. "writeIn": listed in the source as a write-in candidate (not a printed ballot line). From 1954 the Governor and Lieutenant Governor are a single joint contest. "w" follows the source (bold/winning-candidate markup; where a results box marks no winner, the bolded infobox nominee). "dateSource":"rule" would mark a date computed as the first Tuesday after the first Monday of November; every date in this file is stated on a source page.
